arguments.question: For ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, evaluate completed-session 21/63-session technical context versus fixed SPY and sector benchmarks: trend, realized volatility, drawdown, and clearly labeled descriptive support/resistance. Identify whether any current technical condition materially constrains a fundamental thesis; do not forecast or treat levels as trade instructions. Stop with seeded price/comparison evidence.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether observed price structure and relative performance support, conflict with, or merely qualify differentiated 21/63-session research theses.
